verdict.rationale: Mesh can be driven entirely without the web UI. It has REST APIs authenticated with generated API credentials that carry scoped permissions and expiry. It supports sync, async and batch screening, and webhooks such as WORKFLOW_COMPLETED for result handling. Case review and remediation can be done via the API, and exports, rate-limit headers, versioning and a retrievable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema plus Postman collection round out the automation surface. Missing for 10: an official CLI/SDK or CI-specific guidance (e.g. pipeline examples, sandbox environments), and hands-on corroboration of an authenticated automated run.
